question: Momentum of a body depends upon ______.

options.text: both mass and velocity of an object

solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 3**__ i.e __**both mass and velocity of the object**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Momentum**:

 
 
• It is the property of a moving body and is defined as the product of** mass and velocity of the body**__.
 
• SI unit is kg×m/s.
 
• Dimension: MLT−¹
 
• p = mv; p = momentum, m = mass, and v = velocity
 
 
 
• **So the momentum of a body depends upon both mass and velocity of the body.**
